svg.aria-label: Monitoring plasticizer during measurement: at constant temperature, measure conductivity at intervals; only a stable value is reliable, and a steady decline means the plasticizer is evaporating or leaching out. Weigh before and after the test, and open the cell to check whether the surface is wet or oily. In the report, state the plasticizer type, content and mass change.
